maxBoostPercent.description: Maximum boost percentage for machines (100 = no boost, 260 = 2.6x speed)

workerScaling.description: Worker cost scaling for machines (100 = linear, 200% boost needs 2x workers. 0 = free)

energyScaling.description: Electricity cost scaling for machines (100 = linear, 200% boost needs 2x power. 0 = free)

maintenanceScaling.description: Maintenance cost scaling for machines (100 = linear, 200% boost needs 2x maintenance. 0 = free)

transportEnergyScaling.description: Belt/pipe electricity scaling (100 = linear, 200% boost needs 2x power. 0 = free)

beltInventoryBonus.description: Max extra items a speed-boosted belt/pipe holds (100 = up to +100% near max boost, starts near +20% when first boosted, 0 = off). Ramps across the belt's max-boost range and costs up to 3x electricity at full inventory boost. Steps are coarse on faster belts.

beltStackBonus.description: How much more a speed-boosted belt fits into each group of items it carries (200 = up to 3x near max boost, 0 = off). This is what lets connectors feed a boosted belt faster than the normal limit. Items move at the same speed, each group just carries more.

computingScaling.description: Machine computing cost scaling (150 = moderate increase at higher boost. 0 = free)

officeMaxBoostPercent.description: Maximum boost percentage for offices (100 = no boost, 260 = 2.6x speed)

officeComputingScaling.description: Office computing cost scaling (85 = gentler than machines since offices already use vanilla computing boost. 0 = free)

officeWorkerScaling.description: Office worker cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

officeEnergyScaling.description: Office electricity cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

officeMaintenanceScaling.description: Office maintenance cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

officeFocusScaling.description: Office focus output scaling (100 = linear, 200% boost = 2x focus. 200 = double rate, 200% boost = 3x focus. 0 = no extra focus from boost)

oreSorterMaxBoostPercent.description: Maximum boost percentage for ore sorters (100 = no boost, 260 = 2.6x speed)

oreSorterWorkerScaling.description: Ore sorter worker cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

oreSorterEnergyScaling.description: Ore sorter electricity cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

oreSorterMaintenanceScaling.description: Ore sorter maintenance cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

oreSorterCapacityMultiplierT1.description: Extra capacity multiplier for the small (T1) ore sorter, applied on top of the per-building Boost++ slider (100 = no extra, 500 = 5x extra storage). Sorting speed and worker/energy/maintenance costs are NOT affected.

oreSorterCapacityMultiplierT2.description: Extra capacity multiplier for the large (T2) ore sorter, applied on top of the per-building Boost++ slider (100 = no extra, 500 = 5x extra storage). Sorting speed and worker/energy/maintenance costs are NOT affected.

oreSorterSortingSpeedBonus.description: Max sorting speed bonus for ore sorters T1+T2 (50 = vanilla hard limit of +50%, 150 = up to +150% faster sorting at max boost).

wasteMaxBoostPercent.description: Maximum boost percentage for waste sorting plants (100 = no boost, 260 = 2.6x speed)

wasteWorkerScaling.description: Waste sorting worker cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

wasteEnergyScaling.description: Waste sorting electricity cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

wasteMaintenanceScaling.description: Waste sorting maintenance cost scaling (100 = linear. 0 = free)

underboostEnergyScaling.description: Electricity saved when a building is slowed below 100% (100 = fully proportional, a building at 10% speed uses 10% power. 0 = no saving, it costs the same as 100%)

underboostWorkerScaling.description: Workers freed when a building is slowed below 100% (100 = fully proportional, a building at 10% speed needs 10% of its workers. 0 = no saving. Always keeps at least 1 worker)

autoBoostLowFillPercent.description: Auto Boost: storage fill % at or below which the building runs at maximum boost

autoBoostNeutralFillPercent.description: Auto Boost: storage fill % at which the building runs at exactly 100% (no boost, no slowdown)

autoBoostHighFillPercent.description: Auto Boost: storage fill % at or above which the building slows to its minimum boost

autoBoostIntervalMs.description: Auto Boost: how often it recalculates, in milliseconds. Lower reacts faster but reads less settled power and worker numbers.

autoBoostPowerReservePercent.description: Auto Boost: share of total power generation always left unused as a safety margin (10 = keep 10% spare)

autoBoostWorkerReserve.description: Auto Boost: number of free workers always left unassigned as a safety margin

autoBoostStepPercent.description: Auto Boost: granularity of changes. The boost % always lands on a multiple of this.

autoBoostDeadbandPercent.description: Auto Boost: ignores changes smaller than this, to stop buildings twitching between values

autoBoostMaxStepPercent.description: Auto Boost: largest boost % change allowed in a single update

autoBoostMaxTrimStepsPerCycle.description: Auto Boost: when power runs short, the maximum number of slow-down steps applied per update
